ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 98% low-intensity pixels vs 2% high-intensity pixels localized to tips and sparse speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal lateral tips; minor low-intensity speckling on the left interior lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 48 degrees with significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and asymmetrical jaggedness; multiple high-amplitude peaks (serrations) exceeding 15 pixels in depth; frequency is higher on the outer halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the medial notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the extreme left and right apices.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast vertical linear marks visible on the central portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular notches and tissue loss along the trailing edge; white calcified organisms present on the distal edges.
